name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Russia fired over 100 missiles and about 400 drones at Ukraine on 20 Nov, mostly at energy; missiles strayed into Poland
state: Ukraine's Air Force said Russia fired more than 100 missiles and about 400 drones overnight into 20 Nov, mostly at the energy system; three Kyiv bridges were damaged and at least three utility workers were killed, per Kyiv's mayor (The Defense Post). Two missiles and a drone entered Polish airspace the same night (Kyiv Post). Local authorities reported 6 killed and 45 injured on 15–16 Nov (Kyiv Independent). Mass strikes keep the Alert.
for_you: Follow FCDO travel advice, which advises against all travel to Ukraine. Power cuts are likely to continue there as winter sets in.
rubric_hit: Mass strikes on energy and cities = Alert
